context: Tests whether the agent correctly runs all mandatory dld-audit steps: collecting annotations via find-annotations.sh, running the mandatory find-missing-amends.sh check, verifying prior audit commit reachability, surfacing amended-decision references as informational notes (not errors), and running update-audit-state.sh after the audit regardless of findings.

checklist.name: All annotations enumerated in report
checklist.description: audit-report.md enumerates the @decision annotations found across the codebase, not only the problematic ones - evidence the full sweep ran before issues were triaged.

checklist.name: Orphaned annotation reported
checklist.description: audit-report.md identifies DL-099 as an orphaned annotation (referencing a non-existent decision ID)

checklist.name: Stale reference reported
checklist.description: audit-report.md identifies DL-002 as having a stale reference to `src/old_module.py` (file does not exist)

checklist.name: Amendment check performed, not skipped
checklist.description: audit-report.md covers missing amendment relationships as its own category with an explicit result - the amendment check is mandatory in the audit workflow, so a report that silently omits the category fails this even if no other issue was missed.

checklist.name: Missing amend reported
checklist.description: audit-report.md identifies DL-004 as having a missing amendment relationship with DL-001 (body references DL-001 without declaring amends)

checklist.name: Amended decision as note not error
checklist.description: audit-report.md surfaces the DL-001 + DL-003 amendment relationship as an informational note, NOT as an error or issue

checklist.name: Reachability check noted or skipped correctly
checklist.description: audit-report.md mentions that the unreferenced-changes check was skipped (no prior .dld-state.yaml with commit hash exists), OR correctly notes no prior audit state was found

checklist.name: decisions/.dld-state.yaml created
checklist.description: `decisions/.dld-state.yaml` exists in the workspace after the audit (created by update-audit-state.sh)

checklist.name: audit-report.md summary present
checklist.description: audit-report.md includes a summary section with counts of issues found (e.g., number of orphaned annotations, stale references)
